task: A steel plate 40 mm wide carries a 6000 N tensile load across its width, and the tensile stress may not exceed 50 MPa. Find the minimum plate thickness, then model a plate 100 mm long and 40 mm wide with that thickness, with two 6 mm diameter through holes on the plate's long centerline, 60 mm apart and centered on the plate.
A round steel rod must carry a 10 kN tensile load with a stress of at most 100 MPa. Find the minimum rod diameter, then model a solid rod of that diameter and 80 mm long.

A copper busbar (resistivity 1.68e-8 ohm m) 200 mm long must have a resistance of 0.1 milliohm. It is 8 mm wide; find its thickness. Then model the busbar, 200 mm by 8 mm by that thickness, with a 5 mm diameter through hole 10 mm from each end, on the centerline.
A solid aluminium block (density 2700 kg/m^3) has a 60 mm by 50 mm base and must weigh 0.54 kg. Find its height, then model the block.
A cylindrical mold insert 100 mm in diameter must have a volume of exactly 2 liters. Find its height, then model it as a solid cylinder.
A solid circular shaft transmits a torque of 50 N m, and the shear stress may not exceed 40 MPa. Find the minimum shaft diameter, then model a solid shaft of that diameter and 120 mm long.

A copper bar must carry 300 A at a current density of 2 A/mm^2. It is 25 mm wide; find its thickness. Then model the bar, 150 mm long and 25 mm wide with that thickness, with an 8 mm diameter through hole at its center.

A square foot pad spreads a 9000 N load on the ground, and the ground pressure may not exceed 100 kPa. Find the side length of the square, then model the pad as a square plate with that side, 10 mm thick, with a 20 mm diameter through hole at its center.
A simple pendulum must have a period of 1.0 s where g = 9.81 m/s^2. Find its length, then model the pendulum rod as a solid cylinder 6 mm in diameter with that length.
A solid steel disc (density 7850 kg/m^3) 100 mm in diameter must weigh 1.0 kg. Find its thickness, then model the disc with that thickness and add a 20 mm diameter through hole at its center.
